blocks.text: First and largest Filipino life insurance company, InLife, received its 6th 4-Golden Arrow Award from the Institute of Corporate Directors (ICD) setting the benchmark for excellence in corporate governance. The 4-Golden Arrow is the highest distinction conferred by the ICD to top-performing Philippine insurance firms, based on the ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) evaluation. This milestone marks InLife’s sixth 4-Golden Arrow recognition since the ICD began honoring the Company in 2018. Accepting the award, InLife Executive Chair Nina D. Aguas reflected on the deep responsibility behind the recognition. “For a 115-year-old institution like InLife, this award serves as a reminder that […]...
